formation.explanation: A serialized RawNode caller or node.run admits Propose into raft.Step. Followers may forward; candidates or leaderless followers drop. A leader assigns term/index, appends unstable entries, queues a self acknowledgement and replicates MsgApp with predecessor identity. Followers validate the predecessor, refuse committed conflicts, truncate only uncommitted suffixes, and queue append responses. send separates these responses from immediately sendable messages. In async mode ordered durable append work releases responses; synchronous Ready/Advance splits remote and self delivery under caller persistence duties. The leader term-filters replies, requires sender progress, updates Match monotonically, computes the majority-supported index (both majorities for joint membership), and advances only if that index has the current term. Commit is propagated in appends; heartbeats cap commit at the recipient Match. Followers cap append commit at their matched request suffix. Ready exposes committed work with snapshot and application-size guards; async mode additionally requires local stabilization. Applied callbacks are distinct from Ready acceptance and client completion. Propose success promises no commitment.

context.explanation: Authority belongs to a raft instance in a term and installed voter configuration. Election ticks or Campaign require promotability and no unapplied committed configuration change. PreVote can probe the next term without changing current term/vote; real campaigning increments term and queues durable self-vote support. Vote recipients check previous vote/known leader and candidate last-entry freshness. Candidates tally only the response type matching their phase, using configured voter majorities. Winning real election resets progress and appends a current-term empty entry. Higher-term messages generally install follower state, with explicit pre-vote and lease exceptions; stale messages are normally ignored. CheckQuorum may remove leadership; transfer pauses proposals and waits for transferee catch-up. Membership activates through caller application of committed configuration entries, using simple/joint transitions and retained progress. Restart reconstructs saved term/vote/commit and membership but starts follower with no leader. Snapshot acceptance checks obsolescence, follower state and recipient membership before restoring history/configuration or fast-forwarding matching commit.

connection.explanation: Role reset discards vote tallies and remote Match, retains local history/commit, initializes self Match from that history and rebuilds readOnly acknowledgements. A new current-term entry plus quorum/current-term commitment reconnects retained history to new leadership. Configuration activation can reinterpret retained Match and call maybeCommit without a fresh reply. Old queued responses can survive emission, so consumers enforce term filtering; storage append completion additionally matches entry index/log term before trimming unstable memory. Snapshot completion from an older term remains processed, and application responses have term zero, reflecting committed state that outlives authority. Pending read requests awaiting first current-term commit survive reset separately from readOnly acknowledgement state: they are released only after a current-term commit and then enter the selected read confirmation mechanism. Safe reads correlate heartbeat acknowledgements by context and installed voters; returned ReadState is still subject to caller application progress. These mechanisms separate volatile support, established local decisions, durable state and externally served results.

formation.explanation: A serialized RawNode caller or node.run admits Propose into raft.Step. Followers may forward; candidates or leaderless followers drop. A leader assigns term/index, appends unstable entries, queues a self acknowledgement and replicates MsgApp with predecessor identity. Followers validate the predecessor, refuse committed conflicts, truncate only uncommitted suffixes, and queue append responses. send separates these responses from immediately sendable messages. In async mode ordered durable append work releases responses; synchronous Ready/Advance splits remote and self delivery under caller persistence duties. The leader term-filters replies, requires sender progress, updates Match monotonically, computes the majority-supported index (both majorities for joint membership), and advances only if that index has the current term. Commit is propagated in appends; heartbeats cap commit at the recipient Match. Followers cap append commit at their matched request suffix. Ready exposes committed work with snapshot and application-size guards; async mode additionally requires local stabilization. Applied callbacks are distinct from Ready acceptance and client completion. Propose success promises no commitment.

formation.explanation: A serialized RawNode caller or node.run admits Propose into raft.Step. Followers may forward; candidates or leaderless followers drop. A leader assigns term/index, appends unstable entries, queues a self acknowledgement and replicates MsgApp with predecessor identity. Followers validate the predecessor, refuse committed conflicts, truncate only uncommitted suffixes, and queue append responses. send separates these responses from immediately sendable messages. In async mode ordered durable append work releases responses; synchronous Ready/Advance splits remote and self delivery under caller persistence duties. The leader term-filters replies, requires sender progress, updates Match monotonically, computes the majority-supported index (both majorities for joint membership), and advances only if that index has the current term. Commit is propagated in appends; heartbeats cap commit at the recipient Match. Followers cap append commit at their matched request suffix. Ready exposes committed work with snapshot and application-size guards; async mode additionally requires local stabilization. Applied callbacks are distinct from Ready acceptance and client completion. Propose success promises no commitment.

context.explanation: Authority belongs to a raft instance in a term and installed voter configuration. Election ticks or Campaign require promotability and no unapplied committed configuration change. PreVote can probe the next term without changing current term/vote; real campaigning increments term and queues durable self-vote support. Vote recipients check previous vote/known leader and candidate last-entry freshness. Candidates tally only the response type matching their phase, using configured voter majorities. Winning real election resets progress and appends a current-term empty entry. Higher-term messages generally install follower state, with explicit pre-vote and lease exceptions; stale messages are normally ignored. CheckQuorum may remove leadership; transfer pauses proposals and waits for transferee catch-up. Membership activates through caller application of committed configuration entries, using simple/joint transitions and retained progress. Restart reconstructs saved term/vote/commit and membership but starts follower with no leader. Snapshot acceptance checks obsolescence, follower state and recipient membership before restoring history/configuration or fast-forwarding matching commit.

connection.explanation: Role reset discards vote tallies and remote Match, retains local history/commit, initializes self Match from that history and rebuilds readOnly acknowledgements. A new current-term entry plus quorum/current-term commitment reconnects retained history to new leadership. Configuration activation can reinterpret retained Match and call maybeCommit without a fresh reply. Old queued responses can survive emission, so consumers enforce term filtering; storage append completion additionally matches entry index/log term before trimming unstable memory. Snapshot completion from an older term remains processed, and application responses have term zero, reflecting committed state that outlives authority. Pending read requests awaiting first current-term commit survive reset separately from readOnly acknowledgement state: they are released only after a current-term commit and then enter the selected read confirmation mechanism. Safe reads correlate heartbeat acknowledgements by context and installed voters; returned ReadState is still subject to caller application progress. These mechanisms separate volatile support, established local decisions, durable state and externally served results.
